chars.AMAR: AMAR: a skinny young Moroccan man of 26 wearing a slightly too big shiny dark blue suit with a white shirt and a red tie, black pointed shoes.
chars.LADY: LADY: a rich glamorous Moroccan woman in her fifties, chubby, wearing a long shiny pink silk dressing gown with feather trim, big gold necklace and gold bracelets, pink fluffy slippers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Comic awkward moment at the open front door of a luxury white villa in Rabat: LADY leans on the door frame smiling slyly and winking, one hand on her hip; AMAR stands on the doorstep frozen, eyes wide, sweating, holding a small folder against his chest. Both fully visible, facing each other.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: AMAR in a small modest Moroccan bedroom proudly fixing his tie in front of a mirror, chin up, acting like a big businessman, a phone on the bed.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AMAR sitting in the back of a red Rabat petit taxi on a sunny boulevard, looking at the address on his phone with excitement, palm trees outside.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: AMAR standing alone in front of a huge white villa with a big gate, palm trees and a fountain, his mouth wide open in disbelief, scratching his head.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: LADY opening the big wooden villa door in her silk dressing gown, arms wide in a welcoming gesture; AMAR steps back in shock, his tie flying.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A huge luxurious Moroccan salon with velvet sofas and a chandelier: LADY sits very close to AMAR on the sofa, smiling and talking; AMAR sits stiff on the edge of the sofa, clutching his folder, nervous.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: LADY walking up a grand marble staircase, looking back and beckoning AMAR with one finger; AMAR at the bottom of the stairs hesitating, swallowing hard.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On the grand marble staircase: AMAR following LADY upward, sweating heavily and looking at the viewer in panic, LADY ahead of him going up toward a closed bedroom door.
